name: Cambridge YMCA Summer Program
description_short: A full-day summer program (8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m., Monday–Friday) for ages 5–13 at the Cambridge YMCA, licensed by the Massachusetts Department of Early Education and Care. Children are grouped in three age-based classrooms. Enrichment includes swim lessons, outdoor and gross motor play, STEM programs for ages 7–13, teacher-led activities such as arts and crafts, games and cooking, and weekly field trips or special events.
refund_policy_summary: A $150 non-refundable deposit is due for each enrolled week once your child is accepted. The page gives no other refund terms.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swim lessons are listed as part of the program's enrichment. The page does not say where they take place or how swimmers are supervised or tested.
